projects.name: Q3: Data Out — Exports & API
projects.description: Customers keep asking to get their data OUT of Lumen: scheduled CSV/Parquet exports, a stable read API, and webhook delivery. Top-3 churn reason for the enterprise tier.

projects.name: Q3: First-Five-Minutes Onboarding
projects.description: Cut time-to-first-dashboard from 26 minutes to under 5. Auto-detect schema, template gallery, sample data mode.

projects.name: Q4: Smarter Alerts
projects.description: Anomaly-detection alerts instead of static thresholds. Alert fatigue is the #1 complaint from power users.

issues.title: Scheduled CSV export for dashboards
issues.description: Customers want a daily/weekly CSV of any dashboard emailed or pushed to S3. Enterprise blocker for Maxwell Corp renewal ($240k ARR).

issues.title: Read API: stable v1 for query results
issues.description: Versioned REST endpoint returning dashboard query results as JSON. Needs pagination, rate limits, API keys scoped per workspace.

issues.title: Onboarding: auto-detect schema from first connection
issues.description: When a user connects Postgres/Snowflake, infer event tables and suggest 3 starter dashboards. Session replays show users stall at the empty-state screen.

issues.title: Template gallery for first dashboard
issues.description: Curated templates (SaaS metrics, ecommerce funnel, product analytics). One-click apply with sample data.

issues.title: Alert fatigue: digest mode + quiet hours
issues.description: Power users get 40+ alert emails/day. Batch low-severity alerts into a digest; respect per-user quiet hours.

issues.title: Export pipeline: Parquet support
issues.description: Data teams want Parquet, not CSV. Reuse the scheduled-export framework from LUM-341.

issues.title: Dashboard load p95 regressed to 4.1s
issues.description: p95 dashboard load went from 2.3s to 4.1s after the panel-grid refactor. Session replays show users tab away while loading.
